examples.code:
# Create a practical RGB-only Gaussian blur.
blur = nuke.nodes.Blur(name="soften_detail")

# Blur RGB while leaving alpha unchanged.
blur["channels"].setValue("rgb")
blur["filter"].setValue("gaussian")

# Set horizontal and vertical blur independently.
blur["size"].setValue(20.0, 0)
blur["size"].setValue(8.0, 1)

# Keep the bounding box within the project format and blend the effect.
blur["crop"].setValue(True)
blur["mix"].setValue(0.75)
